column_description: One of 1870 unique miRNA ids (aka symbols) contained in this table, eg hsa-mir-21 -- relevant reference information can be found in the isb-cgc:genome_reference dataset in the tables miRBase_v20 and miRBase_v20_hsa_gff3
Corrected and Uncorrected indicator that specify if the miRs were corrected by the EBN+ method. See more details at https://www.synapse.org/#!Synapse:syn6171109
Normalized abundance (i.e., reads per million, RPM)
